request.questionText: Which of the following is an accurate statement about bootstrapping? Indicate below whether each statement is TRUE or FALSE.

blanks.label: Each bootstrap sample must be of a different size than the original sample.
Each bootstrap sample could contain duplicates and omissions from the original sample.
Each bootstrap sample must be sampled with replacement.
Bootstrapping involves repeatedly resampling from the original sample to track the extent to which the estimate varies across samples.
Simulation of a sampling distribution with the bootstrap is one method to reduce our uncertainty related to sampling variance.
